title_tag: 8 Best Cheap Hotels in Budapest (2026): Under €65
meta_description: Cheap hotels in Budapest compared: €45 to €64 a night for two, guest scores 8.2 to 8.9, metro walks, breakfast ratings and which are really central.
h1_main: 8 Best Cheap and Budget Hotels in Budapest
author_role: 8 budget hotels under €65 compared on price, guest scores, location and the walk to the metro
lead: The right cheap hotel in Budapest is the one that saves money without costing you time: a €60 room 328 ft from Oktogon metro (that is Medos, the #1 pick), the best-rated budget hotel at €64, a €46 room by an M2 stop outside the centre, or the cheapest bed in the middle of Pest at €45. Even cheaper? Compare the hostels, which have private rooms too. This page gets you to the right room in under a minute.

To make the choice easy, I compared all 8 on what decides a budget booking: the price for the same night, the guest score and how many reviews it rests on, cleanliness, the location score and the walk to the nearest metro, checked on each hotel's own listing. Filter by central location, under €50 or top scores below, or scroll straight to the ranking.

What the numbers say: €45–64 for two people buys a real hotel room with a private bathroom, and the scores barely move with price: the best-scored hotel here (CZECH INN, 8.9) is the second cheapest. What you trade for the lowest prices is location (CZECH INN is outside the centre) or cleanliness scores (Panorama Central, 8.4). Medos is the balance: 9.5 for location, by a metro stop, for €60.

• Best balance of price and location: #1 Medos.
  • Highest standards on a budget: #2 Central Hotel 21.
  • Cheapest with top scores, happy to ride the metro: #3 CZECH INN.
  • Cheapest in the centre: #4 Panorama Central.
  • Arriving by train at Nyugati: #5 Fashion City.
  • Near City Park and Széchenyi Baths: #7 Benczur.

A little more budget? The best hotels in Budapest start at €89 for a 9.0-rated 3-star.

guide.h2: Before You Book: What Cheap Hotels Leave Out
guide.html:
Breakfast: it is usually an extra on budget rates. Guests rate it wonderful at CZECH INN and excellent at Ibis Budapest City; Panorama Central does not list a breakfast rating.

Check-in and check-out: from 2 pm at Medos, Central 21, Panorama Central and Benczur; Central 21 asks you to leave by 10:30 am, Ibis lets you stay until 12 pm.

Transport: the cheapest rooms sit by metro stops: Astoria (Panorama Central), Oktogon (Medos), Blaha Lujza tér (Ibis), Puskás Ferenc Stadion (CZECH INN). A 72-hour public transport pass can pay for itself; see is the Budapest Card worth it.

Spend what you save on a Danube cruise or a thermal bath.

faqs.q: What is the best cheap hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Medos Hotel: €60 for two on a March weeknight, 8.6 from 8,429 reviews and 9.5 for location, 328 ft from Oktogon metro.

faqs.q: How much is a cheap hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: From €45 to €64 a night for 2 adults on a March weeknight for the eight hotels here, which is €22.50 to €32 per person.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest central hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Budapest Panorama Central at €45, 350 ft from the Dohány Street Synagogue and 450 ft from Astoria metro. Its cleanliness score (8.4) is the lowest here.

faqs.q: Are cheap hotels outside the centre worth it?
faqs.a: CZECH INN Hotel Ferenc is outside the centre in District X but next to the Puskás Ferenc Stadion M2 stop, scores 8.9 and costs €46, so the metro ride is the only trade-off.

faqs.q: Hotel or hostel for a budget trip?
faqs.a: For two people a budget hotel at €45–64 often costs about the same as two hostel beds. Solo travellers save more in a hostel; see our hostel comparison.

methodology: We compared Budapest hotels under €65 for 2 adults on the same night (10 March 2027) with guest scores of 8.2 or higher on at least 1,700 reviews, on price, guest score, cleanliness and location sub-scores, the walk to the nearest metro, breakfast rating and check-in rules, all from each hotel's live listing.
